artworks.title: The Three Graces
artworks.description: Rubens' celebrated painting of the Charites — Aglaea, Euphrosyne, and Thalia — embodies the daughters Hesiod and Apollodorus ascribe to Zeus and the Oceanid Eurynome. The intertwined trio, luminous and tactile, became the canonical modern image of the Graces whose birth from a daughter of Ocean linked the river-line of Tethys to the delight of Olympus.

artworks.title: Hephaestus in the forge (detail showing Thetis)
artworks.description: Paintings of Thetis at Hephaestus' forge recall the debt the goddess owed from her youth: she and Eurynome sheltered the cast-out smith in a cave beneath Ocean for nine years. Artists of the Baroque period often paired the sea-nymph's later embassy for Achilles' armour with the memory of that hidden fosterage.
